titulo_es: «Mentre» and «quando»: two things at a time

texto: When two processes were being developed at the same time in the past, both go in **imperfetto**: **Mentre cucinavo, ascoltavo la musica** (while I was cooking, listening to music); **Mentre io lavoravo, i bambini dormivano** (while I was working, the children were sleeping).

If a point action interrupts what was happening, the bottom action goes with **mentre + imperfetto** and the point action goes in **passato prossimo**: **Mentre cucinavo, è suonato il telefono** (while cooking, the phone rang).

filas: Mentre io leggevo, lui guardava la TV.
Mentre uscivo di casa, ho incontrato Marco.

frases.en: While I was cooking, Luca came.
Hey! What were you doing before?

frases.it: Guardavo la TV e aspettavo un amico.
frases.es: Miraba la tele y esperaba a un amigo.
frases.en: I was watching TV and I was waiting for a friend.
analisis: I was waiting for a friend.

frases.it: Va bene! Lavoravo tutto il giorno a casa.
frases.es: ¡Está bien! Trabajaba todo el día en casa.
frases.en: All right! He worked at home all day.

frases.it: Da bambino abitavo in campagna con i nonni.
frases.es: De niño vivía en el campo con mis abuelos.
frases.en: As a child, I lived in the country with my grandparents.

frases.it: La sera mangiavamo insieme e dormivamo molto.
frases.es: Por la noche comíamos juntos y dormíamos mucho.
frases.en: At night we ate together and slept a lot.

frases.it: Eravamo tutti molto contenti e stavamo bene.
frases.es: Estábamos todos muy contentos y estábamos bien.
frases.en: We were all very happy and we were fine.

bloques.pregunta: What verbal time does «mentre» usually take directly to describe developing action?

opciones.explicacion: «Mentre» introduces the continuous time frame in which another action occurs, demanding imperfect.
The prossimo passage expresses the punctual cut or event, not the development.
«Mentre» in past narrations does not govern the future.

bloques.pregunta: How is it expressed that two actions were produced at the same time in the past?

opciones.explicacion: Both actions in simultaneous development are in imperfect.

opciones.texto: Mentre ho cucinato, ho ascoltato la musica.
opciones.explicacion: The prossimo passage does not describe two parallel continuous processes.

bloques.frase: Mentre io ___ a casa, è suonato il telefono.

opciones.explicacion: The action that was going on when the phone rang goes in an imfect.
I'd present the job as closed before the phone rang.

opciones.texto: He did both at the same time in the past.
opciones.explicacion: Both forms in imperfect express continuous simultaneity.

opciones.texto: First I cooked everything and then I started reading.
opciones.explicacion: It does not indicate a sequence of succession, but a simultaneous sequence.

opciones.texto: I couldn't cook because I spent the afternoon reading.
opciones.explicacion: He claims he was cooking while he was reading.

bloques.frase: Quando sono arrivato a casa, mia sorella dormiva.

opciones.texto: When I got home, my sister was already sleeping.
opciones.explicacion: «Dormiva» was the current state that found who arrived.

opciones.texto: My sister fell asleep right after I arrived.
opciones.explicacion: «Dormiva» expresses a previous action in full development.

opciones.texto: We both went to sleep at the same time.

bloques.frase: Mentre parlavamo è arrivato il treno
bloques.traduccion: While we were talking, the train came.
bloques.explicacion: Ongoing action with mean and punctual interruption in prossimo passage.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «While I was working, Anna came in.»?

opciones.explicacion: Background action in imperfet (lavoravo) and spot event in prossimo (è arrivata).
The times are inverted with respect to the narrative function.
It would present Anna's arrival as a long, non-timely process.

intro: With «mentre» you express that two things were happening at the same time or that one action in progress was interrupted by another.
